body.p: Witch (a tale). There is a big tent on the bank of a river. A husband and wife live in this tent, they have four children, one of them is already rather big. One day the husband went hunting. Before leaving he said to his wife. Now I will be gone for seven days. Then he left. While her husband was away, a witch found traces of the woman. Following the woman's traces, she reached the tent. And at that moment the woman was not at home. The witch stole the woman's little child and went home. The woman came home, but one of her children was missing. She saw traces of the witch near the tent. She followed the witch's traces. She walked long or not, but finally she came to the witchâs tent. She looks through the laps of the tent. A huge cauldron is boiling on the stove, and her child is playing near the stove. The witch is combing her hair so that she can boil the child. The woman showed her breast from under the lap of the tent cover, and the baby came to her breast. The woman grabbed her child and ran home. One day the woman, while her husband was away, went for hay. There the witch found her and killed her. She wrapped the woman's corpse into the grass and carried it home. The man came home from hunting and saw that his wife was absent and all the children were crying. The man went along the traces of the witch. He reached the witchâs tent, looked, and the witch was already boiling her cauldron. The man caught the witch and tied her up with a rope. He is beating and beating her with a stick. While he did like this with her, the witch already began to die. Before she dies, she thinks as follows. Walking along earth seems bad for me, people treat me badly. Now I have to become a disease, and while people donât even know it, I will eat them. After that she disappeared. That's why people always get sick, and some die. This comes from the witch.
